paras: 04 Days Jaipur & Ajmer-Pushkar Tour Package
Tour Code #DR011
Rs.7299/- per person
Day 1: Arrival in Jaipur

Welcome to Jaipur! Upon your arrival at the Jaipur Railway Station or Airport, our representative will give you warm welcome and transfer you to your hotel. After check-in and some relaxation, we will explore the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle - Central gem of Jaipur
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium – Science and stars under one roof
Vidhan Sabha - Government hub
Birla Mandir - Marble marvel
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Cultural hub of Jaipur
In the evening, enjoy a delicious Rajasthani dinner at a resort, complete with folk music and cultural dance in a rural setting. Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 2: Sightseeing in Jaipur
After breakfast, we'll dive into the historic sites of Jaipur:
Hawa Mahal - The famous "Palace of Winds."
City Palace - A fabulous mixture of Rajasthani and Mughal culture.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - A remarkable collection of planetary instruments.
Jal Mahal - The beautiful "Water Palace."
Amer Fort - A majestic fort with stunning views.
Nahargarh Fort - Offering beautiful panoramic views of the city.
In the evening, experience the Light & Sound show at Amer Fort, a magnificent display of lights and sounds. Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 3: Jaipur-Ajmer-Pushkar
After completing your breakfast, we head to Pushkar to visit:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti in Ajmer
Lord Brahma Temple in Pushkar
Enjoy the natural beauty and Comfortably Overnight stay in Pushkar.
Day 4: Pushkar-Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, we return to Jaipur. At the time of your onward journey, you will be dropped off at Jaipur Railway Station or Airport. (The Tour Ends)
Package Inclusions:
* Daily breakfast
* Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes
* Accommodation in 3-star hotels
* Government-approved tourist guide service for sightseeing in Jaipur
* Complimentary accommodation for children below 5 years of age
Package Exclusions:
* Meals other than those specified in the inclusions
* Personal expenses such as tips, telephone calls, and laundry
* Entrance fees to monuments and attractions
* Camera fees
* Any tickets for trains, flights, or buses
* Travel insurance
Things to note
* Prices are quoted per person based on triple sharing.
* Rates may vary during peak seasons such as New Year and Diwali.
